document.about: Transcript of the FOMC Chair's press conference, January 31, 2024. Its first page sets `Transcript of Chair Powell's Press Conference` in bold at the text's size, then the date larger, which the file's own title states as `Transcript of Chair Powell's Press Conference -- January 31, 2024`.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#455): the date, the largest line on the first page, was the document's title. A date is no title, and the heading the file's own title names is.
